description: Morphology of Trinidad, Bolivia: 2007 and 2015 Land Cover Classification is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Group. These raster files represent land cover classifications in Trinidad, Bolivia at two different time periods: March 7, 2007 and June 15, 2015. In order to better understand the changing landscape of Trinidad, imagery covering the entire city was acquired at two different time periods (2007 and 2015). Coverage: the whole world. It has 2 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
